description:
“The dying fantasy manhwa must be revived!”

The author of the fantasy manhwa The World falls into depression after being criticized as "boring". Eventually, he gives up on drawing manhwa altogether. 

Julius, the protagonist of The World, steps in to convince the author to continue. However, all the other characters, excluding Julius, have already abandoned The World  and scattered to other works.

The author gives the enthusiastic Julius an ultimatum: he must bring the scattered lead actors back in order for the author to continue the manhwa's serialization. In response, Julius embarks on a journey to the other works to find his missing comrades...

(Summary from Comikey)
